lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: For the first time since the Master left, the four apprentices stood in one place.
lines.text: For the first time since the Master left, the four apprentices stood in one place.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Look at us. The Master would weep. Mostly at your outfits.
lines.text: Look at us. The Master would weep. Mostly at your outfits.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: The relics aren't a prize. They're a lock.
lines.text: The relics aren't a prize. They're a lock.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Someone is under Crown Hollow, and he's been whispering to me since Emberfall.
lines.text: Someone is under Crown Hollow, and he's been whispering to me since Emberfall.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Obren. The first apprentice. Every battle over the relics feeds him.
lines.text: Obren. The first apprentice. Every battle over the relics feeds him.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: And something down there is still fighting him. I feel it through the roots.
lines.text: And something down there is still fighting him. I feel it through the roots.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: A secret apprentice under the lake.
lines.text: A secret apprentice under the lake.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: And the cure is that I stop the war I'm winning. How convenient.
lines.text: And the cure is that I stop the war I'm winning. How convenient.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: She is not lying, Bishop. I have felt it under the ice. Something counting.
lines.text: She is not lying, Bishop. I have felt it under the ice. Something counting.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Then let it count. Whoever holds the Hollow holds the Master's seat. I intend to sit in it.
lines.text: Then let it count. Whoever holds the Hollow holds the Master's seat. I intend to sit in it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: You sent knives in the night. You took Vey from me. You'll have to go through me.
lines.text: You sent knives in the night. You took Vey from me. You'll have to go through me.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: That was always the plan, little ember.
lines.text: That was always the plan, little ember.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ice stays out of this war.
lines.text: Ice stays out of this war.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Nature too. Win it or lose it without us.
lines.text: Nature too. Win it or lose it without us.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Bring your army. I'll bring mine.
lines.text: Bring your army. I'll bring mine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: At dawn, the war would come home to where it started.
lines.text: At dawn, the war would come home to where it started.
